_comment: Images and links for resume-driven cards. Keys must match the title exactly as it appears in resume/resume/awards.tex or projects.tex. 'label' overrides the displayed title; img/href/icon are optional and fall back to img/placeholder.svg, '#', and a generic icon. The image fallback is a neutral placeholder on purpose - it used to be img/hero.png, which rendered Freddy's portrait as the artwork for any card lacking its own image.

Until then href stays '#', which render_card emits as a non-interactive badge marked as pending rather than as a link that does nothing. Replace href with the real credential URL once available.

Google Cloud Certified: Professional Clo.label: GCP Professional Cloud Architect
Google Cloud Certified: Professional Clo._verify_note: The card links to the PDF above by request. This is the issuer-hosted badge that was previously the href, kept because it is the only independently verifiable credential link in this file: it proves the certification is genuine and current in a way a downloaded PDF cannot. The generator reads only label/img/href/icon, so this field renders nowhere. Swap it back into href to restore the verifiable link.
